description: The file 'Main.java' serves as the entry point for the 'ipcGenerator' command-line utility. It processes command-line options, parses XML service definitions, sets up context for code generation, and orchestrates the use of the Processor class to build models and generate code based on XML service descriptions. It also includes methods for file handling, especially filtering and processing XML files for input.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Entry point class for the 'ipcGenerator' utility, responsible for processing command-line arguments, parsing service definition XML files, setting up context, and invoking processing and code generation routines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that processes command-line arguments, identifies input files, parses XML documents, and coordinates code generation workflow.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects XML files from a directory or returns a list containing a single file, filtering for '.xml' extensions.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions and version info for the utility.
